elements.note: Repeats A-04's 17.20 x 16.20 minimum plot verbatim, including the A/B adjustable setbacks -- the sanitary layout is drawn to the same envelope.

warnings: *** THE EQUIPMENT SCHEDULE ON THIS SHEET IS THE MOST PRICEABLE CONTENT IN THE SANITARY SET, and every item carries a performance figure plus named brands with 'หรือเทียบเท่า'. *** Booster pump: automatic, not less than 200 W, not less than 28 l/min at 12 m head (FUJIKA / HITACHI / MITSUBISHI). Grease trap: prefabricated, not less than 30 litres (PP / DOS / BIOTECH / COTTO). Water tank: stainless, 1 m³, มอก.1989, complete with stand. Septic unit: septic-plus-anaerobic-filter type, not less than 1 m³/day, with four named models.

COMPARE WITH HOUSE 06, WHERE THE SEPTIC SPEC CONTRADICTED ITSELF (SN-01 asked for a proprietary tank of at least 2 m³ while SN-02 detailed site-built concrete rings worth about 1.3 m³). Here there is no such conflict: four specific catalogue models are named -- PP EC-4, DOS DC-1.6Q, BIOTECH BT-1600, COTTO CN1600E1 -- with a stated daily treatment capacity and no site-built alternative anywhere.
THE WATER TANK'S BASE SLAB IS AN RC ITEM THAT NO STRUCTURAL SHEET COVERS: 0.10 m thick with a two-way ø9@0.20 mesh. It has to be picked up from this sanitary drawing or it will be missed.

THREE DIFFERENT FALLS ARE IN USE OUTSIDE THE BUILDING and they are all flatter than the internal pipe falls on SN-01: the RC channel at 1:200, the ø0.20 m concrete pipe at 1:400, against 1:50 and 1:100 inside. Do not carry the internal falls outdoors.

The bypass round the booster pump (ø3/4") means the house still has water on mains pressure if the pump fails -- worth noting because it doubles a short length of pipe that is easy to miss in a take-off.
The two 'จุดต้นท่อลึก 0.60 ม.' marks fix the external drainage datum; with the 1:400 fall they determine every downstream invert.
The minimum plot (17.20 x 16.20 m with the A and B adjustable setbacks) is repeated from A-04 -- architectural and sanitary agree on the envelope.
Manhole count (8) is read off the drawn symbols, not printed, and is flagged count_read_from_symbols.
